points.title: Skull
points.description: The skull consists of cranial and facial bones that protect the brain, house sensory organs, and provide attachment points for muscles of facial expression and mastication.

points.title: Pelvis
points.description: The pelvis is a bony ring formed by the sacrum and hip bones. It transfers weight from the axial skeleton to the lower limbs and protects pelvic and lower abdominal organs.

points.title: Ribs
points.description: The ribs form the thoracic cage, protecting the heart and lungs while supporting respiration through movement at the costovertebral and sternocostal joints.

points.title: Spine
points.description: The spine is a column of vertebrae that protects the spinal cord, supports body weight, and allows controlled motion through its intervertebral joints and curvatures.
